description: AFDU coverage summary for the priority 8 aircraft

Bf_109_E.key_findings: Stall 75 mph IAS clean / 61 mph flaps down. Out-turned by Spitfire and Hurricane. CLmax ~1.4 / 1.9.

Bf_109_F.key_findings: Minimum performance guide only (engine in poor state). Trials incomplete after crash.
Bf_109_F.source: AFDU tactical trials on captured F-2 ES906 1941

Bf_109_G2.key_findings: Mostly qualitative notes from captured G-series.

Fw_190_A.key_findings: ~110 mph IAS stall clean. 20-35 mph faster than Spitfire V. Climb ~450 ft/min better than Spitfire VB up to 25,000 ft. Superior roll. Out-turned by Spitfire. Sudden high-speed stall.
Fw_190_A.source: AFDU reports on captured MP499 and others 1942-43

Spitfire_V.key_findings: Out-turns Fw 190. Inferior in speed and climb to early Fw 190.

Spitfire_I.key_findings: Used as baseline in 1940 Bf 109E fights.

P-51_Mustang_III.key_findings: Speed roughly equal to Spitfire IX at many heights. Climb inferior to Spitfire XIV. Out-turned by Spitfire. Excellent dive.
P-51_Mustang_III.source: AFDU tactical trials vs Spitfire IX/XIV 1944

P-47D.key_findings: Dive advantage clear. Climb and turn inferior to Spitfire. Some low-altitude notes vs Fw 190.
